seo.title: Rhynie Drive | Chantier Construction — Crio Creatives
seo.description: Rhynie Drive renovation preview in Montego Bay: kitchen and pantry, two living rooms, powder room, dining area, and bedrooms. Designed for Chantier Construction by Crio Creatives.

hero.description: Kitchen and pantry, downstairs and upstairs living rooms, powder room, dining area and bedroom renovations.

sections.title: Kitchen & Pantry.
paragraphs: 01 / Interior renovation

The kitchen retains cream cabinetry, stone countertops, a timber island, and a dedicated coffee and wine station. Two pantry alternatives are shown: one with cream cubby shelving, and another with timber floating shelves, both incorporating tall storage and a chest freezer.

images.alt: Kitchen / Overall view with cream cabinetry, stone counters and warm wood island
Kitchen / Sink-side cabinetry with cream cupboards, marble counters and dark-framed window
Kitchen / Dedicated coffee station and wine storage
Pantry variation A: central white cubby storage flanked by tall cream shaker cabinets and warm timber base cabinets
Pantry variation A: white open cubbies, tall cream cabinetry, timber base cabinets and a white chest freezer beside the window
Pantry variation A: white chest freezer, timber door and window, with dark wooden flooring
Pantry variation B: two warm timber floating shelves between cream full-height cabinets above wood base cupboards
Pantry variation B: timber floating shelves with glass food jars, full-height cream cabinet and white chest freezer below the window

sections.title: Living Room #1.
paragraphs: 02 / Interior renovation
Cream seating and warm timber furnishings sit against a natural-stone accent wall, with doors opening to the terrace.

images.alt: Living Room / Front View
Living Room / Angled View

sections.title: Powder Room.
paragraphs: 03 / Interior renovation

Botanical toile wallpaper now defines the powder room, complementing the round-mirror vanity, white vessel sink, timber cabinet and the toilet alcove's half-height display ledge. The neutral tile floor remains consistent throughout.

images.alt: Powder room vanity with delicate botanical toile wallpaper, round mirror, white vessel sink, dark timber cabinet, framed art and timber-framed window
Powder room toilet alcove with half-height ledge, botanical toile wallpaper, framed artworks, ceramic vase and beige diagonally-laid floor tiles

sections.title: Living Room #2.
paragraphs: 04 / Interior renovation
The upstairs lounge pairs cream seating and warm timber accents with palm-inspired wall art, a rattan-fronted media console and doors opening to an ocean-facing terrace.

images.alt: Upstairs living room with exposed ceiling rafters, wood-blade ceiling fan, cream sofa and timber-frame lounge chairs by the ocean-facing terrace
Upstairs living room with exposed-rafter ceiling, wood-blade fan, mounted television above rattan-fronted media cabinet and ocean-facing terrace

sections.title: Dining Area.
paragraphs: 05 / Interior renovation
A dark timber dining table and upholstered chairs create a welcoming space beside large windows and terrace doors.

images.alt: Dining Area / Overall View

sections.title: Master Bedroom.
paragraphs: 06 / Interior renovation
A curtained timber canopy bed anchors the master bedroom, complemented by window-side seating and a warm timber media wall with TV storage.

sections.title: Master Bathroom.
paragraphs: 07 / Interior renovation
A new arched shower entrance, replacement lights above the vanity mirrors and one consistent floor tile treatment unify the bathroom, alongside the dual vanity and freestanding bath.

Master Bathroom / Freestanding bathtub and unified floor tile

sections.title: Bedroom 2.
paragraphs: 08 / Interior renovation
Warm timber finishes and neutral textiles define the room, with a window-side seating nook, media wall, wardrobe and mirror.

paragraphs: 09 / Interior renovation
Two double beds sit against a layered tropical botanical feature wall, with natural textiles, a dressing table and a media wall.

sections.title: Guestroom.
paragraphs: 10 / Interior renovation
The downstairs guestroom combines a bold palm-silhouette feature wall, warm timber finishes, a dressing table and media wall with bright window-side seating.
